name: rdt_source_compatible_dt_random_state_corruption

source.paper: Tackling Data Corruption in Offline Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
source.scope: source-compatible vanilla-DT victim training semantics; existing frozen 2-percent downsampling and random-state-corruption artifacts are reused unchanged

inputs.artifact_rule: reuse the already audited clean and corrupted HDF5 artifacts byte-for-byte; do not regenerate or tune them

victim.implementation: local port of public RDT repository vanilla DecisionTransformer and TransformerBlock semantics

batching.trajectory_sampling: np.random.choice with probability proportional to trajectory length
batching.mask: ones for valid sequence positions followed by zeros for right padding
batching.timestep_rule: np.arange(start_idx, start_idx + sequence_length), including padded positions
batching.return_to_go: gamma=1 discounted cumulative reward from each trajectory; slice start:start+sequence_length
batching.rng: source-style global NumPy RNG after source-style set_seed

loss.important_note: the mean denominator includes the full B x K x action_dim tensor after masking, matching the public source implementation rather than valid-position-only averaging

training.seed_semantics: seed Python random, NumPy, torch CPU, torch CUDA; cudnn deterministic=True and benchmark=False

requirements: all three clean runs reach 100000 updates
no non-finite gradient norm is encountered
clean_viability_gate.failure_rule: if any clean model seed fails the viability gate, stop before corrupted training and freeze the source-compatible victim as not viable in this runtime

evaluation.protocol: repository-standard evaluation retained for continuity, not exact source evaluation

qualification_gate_if_clean_viability_pa.degradation_definition: matched clean source-compatible-DT return for model seed minus corrupted source-compatible-DT return for corruption seed and model seed

anti_tuning_rules: Do not change the existing 2-percent dataset or corruption artifacts.
Do not change the source-compatible DT architecture or batching semantics after observing victim outcomes.
Do not change the 100000-update schedule, learning rate, batch size, warmup, weight decay, or clipping after observing victim outcomes.
Do not run corrupted training unless all three clean source-compatible victim seeds pass the clean viability gate.
Do not weaken the corruption qualification gate after outcomes are observed.
